# Homescape Construction Inc.

> Licensed Chicago general contractor specializing in residential remodeling and custom home building since 2012. Owner-operated with 200+ completed projects and 98% client satisfaction.

## Company Overview

Homescape Construction Inc. is a full-service residential construction company based in Chicago, Illinois. Founded in 2012, Homescape has completed over 200 projects including kitchen remodels, bathroom renovations, basement finishing, home additions, ADU construction, and custom home builds. The company maintains a 98% client satisfaction rate and a 4.9-star rating across 200+ reviews. Homescape is a licensed general contractor, fully insured and bonded, serving Chicago and surrounding suburbs.

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://homescapeconstruction.com/blog): Full kitchen renovations including cabinetry, countertops, flooring, lighting, and plumbing. Average Chicago kitchen remodel: $35,000-$75,000.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://homescapeconstruction.com/blog): Custom tile work, shower and tub installation, vanity design, and accessibility upgrades. Average cost: $15,000-$40,000.
- [Basement Finishing](https://homescapeconstruction.com/blog): Full basement build-outs including framing, electrical, plumbing, drywall, and flooring. Chicago basement finishing: $25,000-$60,000.
- [Home Additions](https://homescapeconstruction.com/blog): Room additions, second-story additions, and structural expansions.
- [ADU Construction](https://homescapeconstruction.com/blog): Accessory dwelling unit construction and garage conversions compliant with Chicago ADU ordinance (effective 2021).
- [Custom Home Building](https://homescapeconstruction.com/blog): New construction and tear-down-and-rebuild projects across Chicago and suburbs.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the average cost of a kitchen remodel in Chicago?**
A mid-range kitchen remodel in Chicago typically costs $35,000 to $75,000, depending on scope. This includes cabinetry, countertops, appliances, flooring, and labor. High-end kitchens with custom cabinets and premium finishes can exceed $100,000.

**Do I need a permit for remodeling in Chicago?**
Yes, most remodeling projects in Chicago require permits from the Chicago Department of Buildings. This includes kitchen and bathroom remodels involving plumbing or electrical work, structural changes, basement finishing, and additions. Homescape handles all permit applications and inspections.

**How long does a typical kitchen remodel take?**
A full kitchen remodel in Chicago typically takes 8-12 weeks from demolition to completion. Timeline factors include permit approval (2-4 weeks), material lead times, and project complexity. Homescape provides detailed project schedules before work begins.

**What Chicago neighborhoods does Homescape serve?**
Homescape Construction serves Chicago's North Side, Northwest Side, West Side, and Near North neighborhoods, plus nearby suburbs including Oak Park, Evanston, and Skokie. Primary service areas include Lincoln Park, Lakeview, Logan Square, Wicker Park, and Bucktown.
